title: “High Potential” Child Star Matthew Lamb, 14, Mourns Death of His Mom: ‘She Was Everything to Me’
text:

 Matthew Lamb remembered his mother Meredith as a woman who “loved and supported everyone authentically”
 Brenton Blanchet Tue, October 20, 2026 at 4:04 p.m. UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Matthew Lamb and Meredith Lamb
Credit: Matthew Lamb/Instagram NEED TO KNOW
 High Potential actor Matthew Lamb paid tribute to his mother days after her death
 Lamb shared a post on Instagram, remembering his mom Meredith as "everything to me"
 Several friends, loved ones and the Broadway Artists Alliance also paid tribute
 High Potential star Matthew Lamb is remembering his mother Meredith after her death.
 The 14-year-old actor, who plays Elliot Radovic in the ABC series, shared a tribute on Instagram Monday, Oct. 19, announcing to his followers that his mother died on Saturday, Oct. 17.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I'm not quite sure how to write this. As I'm sure many of you know, my mama passed away this Saturday. She was everything to me," Matthew wrote in a caption. "She taught me school, she taught me empathy, she did everything for our family. She always had the biggest smile and she gave the best hugs. Truly the most selfless person I know."
 He added that "it still doesn't feel real" and that he's "not sure it ever will," remembering his mother as a woman who "loved and supported everyone authentically."
 The Broadway Artists Alliance also remembered Meredith on Monday, noting that she served as BAA's parent liaison, "although that title doesn't begin to capture even 1% of what she meant to our BAA family."
 "I'm not sure how we're going to get through this, but we're going to try," Matthew wrote in his caption. "Every day I'm going to miss telling her about my day, and talking to her and watching our favorite shows. This isn't something I ever thought I would have to do. There's so much she is going to miss in my life, but I'm grateful for the things she was able to experience."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He concluded, "I love you, Mama."
 Matthew's message was paired with an Instagram post featuring images of him and his family over the years, as well as a glimpse at a performance dedicated to her. Meredith was also remembered by some of Matthew's friends and industry peers, as Matthew shared an additional message to those showing support on his Instagram Stories: "I am so incredibly grateful for all of the support we have received," he wrote. "Even if I don't respond, please know how much it means to me."
 Matthew Lamb with his mom Meredith 
 Credit: Matthew Lamb/Instagram 
 Matthew has played Elliot, the son of Kaitlin Olson 's Morgan Gillroy, since the show's debut in 2024. He has also appeared in Only Murders in the Building , Sofia the First: Royal Magic and on stage in various productions.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The BAA shared in its own message that Meredith "transformed our BAA community in immeasurable ways" in the last six years. "She was the biggest champion for every student, staff member, and parent, and quickly became the glue that held our family together," the message read. "No matter how long you had known Meredith — years, hours, or mere minutes — she took the time to listen, encourage, and lift you up. You were genuinely special to her from the moment you met her… and we know how incredibly special she became to all of you, too."
 The tribute remembered Meredith as someone who "took tremendous pride and joy in being everyone's biggest cheerleader, a trusted resource, and, above all, a dear friend."
 BAA is working with her family to honor her "extraordinary legacy" moving forward, including with scholarships in her name "to help young artists pursue their dreams."
